author: GamesIndustry.biz
text:
"You are still taking 100% of the risk" – Why Cairn dev The Game Bakers backs self-publishing for all but the smallest developers

Self-publishing is now firmly established as a viable route to market for indie developers, with many only looking to publishers for help with specific issues – chiefly marketing, based on conversations with GamesIndustry.biz this year. Audrey Leprince, co-founder of Cairn developer The Game Bakers, argues that while working with third parties is essential, self-publishing is ultimately the only route to sustainability for indie developers.

Splitscreen Croatia conference offers attendance packages for developers looking to showcase unreleased games to publishers and investors

Splitcreen Croatia, the new industry conference seeking to fill the gap left by Reboot Develop, has opened applications for its Official Selection showcase, which includes free accommodation and exhibition space for developers with unreleased games.

text:
GTA 6 was the "biggest launch in PlayStation history", with the highest number of concurrent players ever

Christmas did not come early for Sony, but it came close: the firm has declared that GTA 6 was the largest game launch in the platform's history, driving a record number of concurrent players on its November 19th launch, although the number of new consoles playing the game fell short of year-end highs.

UK mobile developers can now apply for their share of a £260 million Google settlement

UK developers who released games, apps or content on the Google Play Store between August 2018 and July 2026 can now claim for their share of a £260 million settlement agreed in a class action suit earlier this year.
